verdict.rationale: Zamzar's own docs say it supports hundreds of formats, including documents, and show a convert-to-PDF example flow, so document-to-PDF conversion is a first-party capability. But no evidence names Word, Excel or PowerPoint as source formats, or any conversion between office formats. Missing for 10: explicit DOCX/XLSX/PPTX-to-PDF support, office-to-office conversions (e.g. DOC↔DOCX, XLSX↔ODS, PPT↔PPTX), a published format matrix for office files, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: We support 100's of different file formats including documents, videos, images, audio, CAD, eBooks and more.
